codeReview.summary: The runtime code already has separate frame and scene deferred replay caches, but this feature only added RetainedViewRuntime coverage and did not fully satisfy the parity-harness contract for focused scene-path evidence. Scene-path ordering for replayed deferred overlays and nested deferred subtrees is still missing from ScenePainterTests, and the backend-switch tests only cover scroll-indicator deferred draws rather than both deferred payload kinds.

issues.description: The only deferred scene-path test here checks initial scroll-indicator flush order. There is still no focused ScenePainter coverage for replayed deferred overlays or nested deferred subtree ordering, even though validation-contract.md requires ScenePainterTests evidence for VAL-PARITY-004 and VAL-PARITY-005. The feature therefore does not actually prove the claimed 'both paths' behavior on the focused suite named by the contract.

The scene-to-frame and frame-to-scene switch tests only construct scroll-indicator deferred draws via showsScrollIndicator. They never exercise deferred subtree payloads, even though the runtime handles two incompatible deferred payload kinds (.scrollIndicator and .subtree in Sources/SwiftWindowsUI/Runtime.swift). That leaves backend-switch rerun safety for deferred subtree payloads unproven.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The runtime-host-worker skill does not explain that deferred subtree scene semantics depend on runtime-owned prepaint state, so raw ScenePainter.paint() is not a reliable harness for those cases. That gap led this worker to add ScenePainter tests, discover they could not exercise the behavior, and then delete them.

Let me remove those specific ScenePainter tests"; .factory/skills/runtime-host-worker/SKILL.md does not mention this constraint.

summary: Review failed. Commit d0bf0e6 adds useful RetainedViewRuntime parity tests, but it does not complete the focused scene-path proof required for VAL-PARITY-004/005, and backend-switch coverage still does not exercise deferred subtree payload reruns.
